name: task
description: Compact go-task output — strip task headers, keep command results

tests.name: strips task headers, keeps output
tests.input:
task: [build] go build ./...

task: [test] go test ./...
ok  myapp 0.5s

task: Task "lint" is up to date

tests.name: preserves error output
tests.input:
task: [build] go build ./...
./main.go:10: undefined: foo
task: Failed to run task "build": exit status 1
tests.expected:
./main.go:10: undefined: foo
task: Failed to run task "build": exit status 1

tests.name: all up to date
tests.input:
task: Task "build" is up to date
task: Task "lint" is up to date
